title: ATTP dominates the 2025 Moldova National Championship
body_html:
The 2025 Republic of Moldova team table tennis championship has come to an end after three stages held at different venues, bringing together the strongest teams in the country. The competition moved at a fast pace, with close duels and performances that clearly reflected the technical progress of Moldovan players.

A remarkable feature of this edition was the make-up of the podium, taken largely by teams of ATTP members who regularly play in SETKA Cup tournaments. Their results confirm once again that the project developed over 4 years in the Republic of Moldova, built on regular competition and high-level training, is producing solid results and directly helping to shape top players.

The three steps of the podium went as follows:

1st place –

Denis ȚERNA, Serghei CUCEROVSCHII, Ion DANILOV, Andrei ȘTIRBU

2nd place –

Veniamin DUBROVIN, Oleg DOBRJINSCHI, Danila TITOV, Maxim UNGUREAN

3rd place –

Demik YING, Daniel BELIBOV, Evghenii COȘCIUG, Artemii IACUBENCO

The 2025 edition leaves behind a hard-fought, mature championship with a steadily rising technical level. A podium made up of ATTP members and SETKA Cup players is one of the clearest signs that the intense competitive rhythm and professional environment these athletes train in have a direct impact on performance.
